claims.cytotoxic_mechanism: Dexamethasone at 2.5 uM is expected to be largely inactive as a direct cytotoxic agent in a 5-day pooled viability screen; glucocorticoid receptor-mediated apoptosis is restricted to lymphoid lineages and is unlikely to produce a reproducible killing pattern across 578 cell lines.
